strategy.primaryIdentity: Stylized fantasy textures establish shape language and readable material character.
strategy.hybridSupport: H5.100 realistic CC0 sources may contribute restrained grain, wear, and material truth.
strategy.academyAuthoredLater: Stains, soot, rivets, edge accents, bronze warmth, crooked goblin wear, and alchemical residue remain future authored layers.
